data.name: Zawarina
data.long_meaning: The name Zawarina is of Arabic origin and means 'Golden Flower'. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'zawar' which means 'gold' and 'rina' which means 'flower'. It is a beautiful name for a baby girl and evokes images of joy and happiness.
